versions.name: Seven Mountains Scout Camp
versions.address: 227 Sand Mountain Road Spring Mills, Pennsylvania 16875

features.note: The Don Bailey Campfire Circle beside Seven Mountains Lake.
A base for backpacking expeditions on the Mid State Trail.
Rustic wood-stove-heated cabins, plus plumbed and electrified lodges.
Tent sites served by electrified pavilions.
An outdoor chapel overlooking Gherity Run.
A heated dining hall with indoor plumbing and a full-service kitchen.
A five-mile single-track bike loop entirely on the property, within the state-forest trail network.

provenance.notes: Name corrected 2026-07-22 (community/data-quality review): 'Scouts BSA Resident' was a scraped registration-event title; renamed to the property name, verified against the council's camp listing. Prior id 'pa-scouts-bsa-resident' retired (resolves via aliases.json). Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/497-102563); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
